title: Prepare single-authority relationship changes
statement: The Definition editing Module shall prepare explicit relationship changes against one selected model state, author each fact only in its profile-declared representation, and derive consistent endpoint views from the confirmed resulting state while preserving actual rejection and incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Relationship edits can duplicate authority, accept invalid facts or produce inconsistent endpoint observations.

why.rationale: SR-008 requires one authoritative relationship and state-consistent forward and inverse views.

conditions: A relationship is created, replaced or removed in a selected model state.

contexts: MOD-002 within MOD-016 using IF-001 and IF-002.

how.approach: Use explicit candidate and base identities, profile-governed representation, complete scoped checks and truthful outcome reporting.

how_much.scope: The MOD-002 contribution to SR-008; other owners retain their own obligations.

acceptance_criteria: For create, replace and remove requests, identify the original fact where applicable, intended typed endpoints, governing profile and expected base; prepare exactly one authoritative representation without an authored inverse.

For requirement parent edits, use the declared containment representation and preserve entity identity; treat semantic reparenting as an explicit relationship change requiring applicable authority, never as a same-entity rename.
Submit the complete affected candidate and checking scope to IF-002 and IF-001; report invalid, unsupported, changed-state or incomplete outcomes without claiming acceptance.
After confirmed retention, derive both endpoint views from the same resulting state; replacement and removal cannot leave the prior inverse in that current view.
Bind each derived view to its state and profile; invalidate derived caches by state and preserve historical observations without mixing states.

If retention or subsequent view acquisition is incomplete, expose known effects and affected scope separately; do not turn uncertain retention into a completed accepted change or a missing view into a rolled-back write.
constraints: Design allocation only; no implementation or verification claim.

sources.basis: Derive single-fact relationship editing, candidate admission and retention boundaries from SR-008. Proposed Design only; no runtime implementation or satisfaction claim.
